raw_record.question_text: As shown in the figure, line $EF$ intersects line $CD$ at point $O$, $\angle AOB=90^\circ$, $OC$ bisects $\angle AOF$. If $\angle AOE=30^\circ$, please write directly the measure of $\angle BOD$ in degrees.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: from O, OA points to the right, OB upward, OE upper-right, OF lower-left on the same straight line as OE, and OC lower-right with OD its opposite ray. From the text, use ∠AOE = 30°, ∠AOB = 90°, and OC bisects ∠AOF. Since OE and OF are opposite rays on line EF, ∠AOF is supplementary to ∠AOE, so ∠AOF = 180° - 30° = 150°. Because OC bisects ∠AOF, ∠AOC = 75°. Since CD is a straight line, OD is opposite OC, so the direction of OD is 180° from OC. Equivalently, compare with OB: OB is 90° from OA, while OD lies 15° to the left of OB, giving ∠BOD = 15°.

推理：已知 ∠AOE=30°。因为 OE 与 OF 是直线 EF 上的相反射线，所以 ∠AOF=180°-30°=150°。又因为 OC 平分 ∠AOF，所以 ∠AOC=150°÷2=75°，即 OC 位于 OA 下方 75°。OD 与 OC 是直线 CD 上的相反射线，因此 OD 的方向相对 OC 转 180°。OB 与 OA 成 90°，而 OD 比 OB 向左偏 15°，所以 ∠BOD=15°。

method.method_draft: Use an oriented-angle or bearing setup. Read the figure so OA is the baseline ray pointing right and OB points straight up; OE is above OA and OF is the opposite ray, while OC is the lower-right bisector ray and OD is opposite OC. From the text, assign direction OA = 0° and, because ∠AOE = 30°, set OE = 30°. Since EF is a straight line, OF has direction 30° + 180° = 210°. The smaller angle ∠AOF shown through the lower side has size 150°, so its bisector OC has direction halfway along that lower sector: (360° + 210°)/2 interpreted from 0° clockwise to 210°, giving OC at 285° or -75°. Since CD is a straight line, OD is opposite OC, so OD has direction 105°. Since ∠AOB = 90° and OB is the upward ray, OB has direction 90°. Therefore ∠BOD = |105° - 90°| = 15°.
